column1: # Combinations are NOT collapsed to one ingredient. Mapping "Augmentin" to amoxicillin alone would
# hide the clavulanic acid from the interaction check and let the substitution engine price a

# multi-ingredient row resolves to a combination that is expanded for interaction checking and
# scripts/build_brand_aliases.py validates every row against the catalogue and the confusable-pair
# blocklist before anything here reaches the graph. A brand naming an ingredient that does not
# exist is rejected loudly rather than dropped quietly.
